author: introvoyz041
description:
An intermediate dataset for US molecular patent grants
	

Retrieves patent grant data from USPTO weekly releases bulkdata.uspto.gov/data/patent/grant/redbook/{year} and keeps only patents with .mol files for downstream data mining use cases.
Compared to existing work such as [https://github.com/learningmatter-mit/PatentChem/tree/main]. We keep all files of a patent grant, especially .til image files. We also share the data as a git lfs repo instead of a single .zip file to allow easier… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/introvoyz041/uspto-mol.
